propositions: Nine modules are at or within 20 LOC of the 800-LOC cap, blocking well-formed changes like adding one parameter to finalize_verdict across five call sites
gate_dispatch.py has only 1 line of headroom but contains three of the five finalize_verdict call sites, making it the critical blocker for story 343b gap-5

The plan-review recovery cluster in gate_dispatch (STEP_* constants, recovery functions, metrics attachment) forms a self-contained call-graph seam with zero external monkeypatch dependencies and can extract to plan_review_recovery.py without test edits

The context-assembly cluster in orchestrator (assemble_context_cache, assemble_context, related helpers) is a run-scoped seam that can extract to context_assembly.py while keeping finalize_verdict in orchestrator with sufficient headroom for 343b's parameter addition

The code-review gate cluster in gate_dispatch must NOT be extracted in this ticket because code_review_enabled is monkeypatched by string on the module object at 14 sites, and relocating its caller would silently break all patches
